title: Causal Factors of Anxiety and Depression in College Students: Longitudinal Ecological Momentary Assessment and Causal Analysis Using Peter and Clark Momentary Conditional Independence
limitations: - Weekly sampling may not capture rapid fluctuations in mental states; - Limited coverage of symptoms due to minimal questions; - Potential underestimation of causal influences due to time lag; - Moderating factors like gender or socioeconomic status not fully explored.
notes: The paper does not explicitly mention preregistration. Code and data availability are declared in the paper, but supplementary materials or repositories are not directly linked in the provided text. The authors used Tigramite for PCMCI estimation and qgraph for visualization.
